meta.safetyAndLegalNoticeEn: All hijacked, affiliate, and compromised domains are strictly defanged ([.], hxxps://). Zero clickable links to gambling sites are included (Art. 29 Polish Gambling Act), and per-host plugin/PHP versions and injected subpage paths on live Vector B1 victim servers are redacted.
